entries.comment: STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-001: Verify the signed Phase 9A commitment before auditing any Phase 10 output.
STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-002: Prove exact open-bank denominators, hashes, role disjointness, grouping, and projection parity.
STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-003: Prove complete method attempts, registered grids/seeds, calibration chronology, budgets, and failure retention.
STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-004: Prove public validation was inspection-only and all integrity, abstention, and power evidence is retained.
STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-005: Build the content-addressed freeze candidate from all claim-relevant code, configs, methods, and checkpoints.
STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-006: Emit the zero-gap Phase 10 verdict only after every WorkPlan gate passes.
STEP LOG P10-AUDIT-FAIL: Retain the exact blocking cause of any Phase 10 compliance failure.
STEP LOG P10-BANK-001: Load exact Section 5.1.2 volumes and create only registered open-bank roots.
STEP LOG P10-BANK-002: Seal one complete role after all six domains and five tracks reach exact denominators.
STEP LOG P10-BANK-003: Retain hashes, counts, role isolation, and cross-profile identity alignment for every open-bank shard.
STEP LOG P10-FINALIZE-001: Load only the complete v2 bank, training, and validation receipts without executing or selecting a method again.
STEP LOG P10-FINALIZE-002: Re-execute the strengthened audit after the audit-scanner correction and before writing the run summary.
STEP LOG P10-FINALIZE-003: Retain the final zero-gap verdict and stop before Phase 11.
STEP LOG P10-PREFLIGHT-001: Probe the exact locked backends and accelerator without installing or substituting a method.
STEP LOG P10-PREFLIGHT-002: Instantiate the frozen MLP and scalar architectures to distinguish architecture defects from unavailable training compute.
STEP LOG P10-PREFLIGHT-003: Bind every retained failure to a concrete registered-resource or prerequisite failure.
STEP LOG P10-PREFLIGHT-004: Retain the non-substitution evidence and prohibit imputed scientific metrics for failed methods.
STEP LOG P10-REPAIR-001: Hash every P-only and Raw-G identity, label, and feature byte before regenerating the Oracle-only representation.
STEP LOG P10-REPAIR-002: Regenerate every open-bank container with lossless Oracle labels and no change to P-only or Raw-G projections.
STEP LOG P10-REPAIR-003: Retain the byte-equivalence and full Oracle reconstruction proof before downstream reruns.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-001: Generate all five exact-volume open roles before any training attempt.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-001A: Prove the corrected Oracle representation leaves P-only and Raw-G identities, labels, and features unchanged under regeneration.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-001B: Record exact backend and compute availability before any registered method attempt.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-002: Execute registered training/fixed readiness and retain every success or failure.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-003: Freeze calibration-policy choices and execute inspection-only public validation.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-004: Run the complete zero-gap audit and create the method-freeze candidate.
STEP LOG P10-RUN-005: Retain the complete Phase 10 outcome and stop before Phase 11.
STEP LOG P10-TEST-001: Discover the complete repository regression and Phase 10 stress suite.
STEP LOG P10-TEST-002: Replay Phase 10 integrity and freeze-candidate gates after all regression tests.
STEP LOG P10-TEST-003: Retain exact regression denominators and the final compliance verdict.
STEP LOG P10-TRAIN-001: Verify the Phase 9A commitment before the first model or fixed-method execution.
STEP LOG P10-TRAIN-002: Load matched full-volume role-isolated projections for all three access profiles.
STEP LOG P10-TRAIN-003: Execute one complete registered CPU-compatible grid with all three seeds.
STEP LOG P10-TRAIN-004: Retain every unavailable accelerator or pinned-weight execution as an unsuppressed method failure.
STEP LOG P10-TRAIN-005: Fit each successful model calibrator exactly once on calibration_fit after selection freeze.
STEP LOG P10-TRAIN-006: Retain selected checkpoints, complete trial histories, failures, environment, and commitment identity.
STEP LOG P10-VALIDATE-001: Select terminal policies once on calibration_policy with the frozen lexicographic constraint.
STEP LOG P10-VALIDATE-002: Execute every ready fixed or trained method once on inspection-only public validation.
STEP LOG P10-VALIDATE-003: Freeze public precision, minimum effects, statistical procedures, and the primary architecture comparison.
